where: harvest titles and abstract starts, screened with tools/views/screen_candidates.py; WebSearch result titles and links (no snippets were returned)
chased: the queue's nearest measured relative for corner_hz is bee#159 (Bombus terrestris, Skorupski and Chittka 2010, 10.1523/jneurosci.5700-09.2010), an order-level record that no carry rule allows; the harvest ran its one citation step on the source of the interommatidial cell's relative, 10.1242/jeb.228460 (works citing it that name Oecophylla: 0), and none on this one; the Formicidae vision review (family review; 1623 hits) stands as the citation step

screened.10.1007/s000400050014: field study of prey concealment and patrolling by Oecophylla smaragdina workers; "temporal" is the timing of patrols, with no photoreceptor or flicker measurement
screened.10.33307/entomon.v49i2.1168: light and scanning electron microscopy of the compound eyes of Camponotus compressus castes (another genus); "temporal" refers to temporal niches, with no photoreceptor frequency measurement

note: WebSearch returned result titles and links only, so web results were judged by title. Both flicker searches returned pages of Ogawa et al. 2023 (10.1007/s00359-023-01629-7), which main read in full (oa-5) and logged for flicker fusion (132 Hz) and for the flash impulse response (latency, time to peak, duration); sweep-26 records that the paper reports no corner frequency. The other results were the flicker compilations of Lafitte et al. 2022 and Inger et al. 2014, which tabulate fusion frequencies, and pages unrelated to ant photoreceptors. No in-hand corner frequency compilation covers Hymenoptera (Laughlin and Weckström 1993 covers Diptera), so canon is empty. interommatidial_deg has no record: the 2017 bioRxiv preprint on the eye organization of O. smaragdina (10.1101/193243) shows an interommatidial angle in its Figure 4E (sweep-26), and it is on the wanted list.
